'''Tomb zombies''' are enemies that can be found in the [[Crypt (Wilderness)|Wilderness crypt]] during [[Ancient Awakening]]. They drop three [[dragonkin artefact]]s when killed.

Their [[life points]] scale with the player's [[combat level]].
